method: Canonical RGB resampling, one 3px median filter, 12-color median-cut quantization, per-color horizontal-run vector paths. No brightness floodfill or semantic mask.
limits: Artificial root cuts at left/bottom ROI boundaries; not a whole-wave silhouette.
Color classes preserve appearance but do not establish foam/paper or water/ink semantics.
Fixed reference-derived reconstruction; no procedural variation or production claim.
